run_generate_partitions: run the CLI tool to partition SC2 replay files into balanced groups by file size
enumerate_replays: enumerate which SC2 replay files still need conversion by comparing source and converted directories
partition_replays_by_size: partition a list of replay hashes into groups with roughly equal total file size
write_partition_files: write newline-separated replay hash lists to text files for parallel dataset processing
review_main_pipeline: review the main pipeline that chains enumerate, partition, and write functions for replay dataset generation
